correctness.rationale: Disjoint witnesses require exactly 2k positive coordinates. Exact first differences are proved for every k; binomial unimodality gives strict increase to ceil(n/3), and factorial ratios with an independently derived three-coin coupling at n divisible by three prove all remaining differences are strictly negative. The KL exponent follows by elementary binomial large deviations. 1,311,695 standalone assertions corroborate all n through 1100 and the coupling for 150 cases; finite tests are not treated as proof.
